items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Terminology 99:1
items.html: Tzitzit means 'hairs,' from the language of the verse 'and He took me by the tzitzit of my head, etc.' And it is from the aspect of the spikes of the hairs of ZA that shine in the head of the Nukva and bring out in her forehead the aspect of tefillin. See Answer 78 above. (Page 360, Item 139).
